verses.text: For the choirmaster. According to Gittith. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. How lovely is Your dwelling place, O LORD of Hosts!

xrefs.text: One thing I have asked of the LORD; this is what I desire: to dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to gaze on the beauty of the LORD and seek Him in His temple.
Send out Your light and Your truth; let them lead me. Let them bring me to Your holy mountain and to the place where You dwell.
They feast on the abundance of Your house, and You give them drink from Your river of delights.
A song of ascents. Of David. I was glad when they said to me, “Let us go to the house of the LORD.”
until I find a place for the LORD, a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob.

verses.text: My soul longs, even faints, for the courts of the LORD; my heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.

xrefs.text: My soul longs for You in the night; indeed, my spirit seeks You at dawn. For when Your judgments come upon the earth, the people of the world learn righteousness.
For the choirmaster. A Maskil of the sons of Korah. As the deer pants for streams of water, so my soul longs after You, O God.
My soul faints for Your salvation; I wait for Your word.
A Psalm of David, when he was in the Wilderness of Judah. O God, You are my God. Earnestly I seek You; my soul thirsts for You. My body yearns for You in a dry and weary land without water.
My flesh and my heart may fail, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.

verses.text: Even the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she places her young near Your altars, O LORD of Hosts, my King and my God.

xrefs.text: He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High will abide in the shadow of the Almighty.
A prayer of Moses the man of God. Lord, You have been our dwelling place through all generations.
Jesus replied, “Foxes have dens and birds of the air have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay His head.
Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my greatest joy. I will praise You with the harp, O God, my God.
Return to your rest, O my soul, for the LORD has been good to you.

verses.text: How blessed are those who dwell in Your house! They are ever praising You. Selah

xrefs.text: Surely goodness and mercy will follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the house of the LORD forever.
Blessed is the one You choose and bring near to dwell in Your courts! We are filled with the goodness of Your house, the holiness of Your temple.
One thing I have asked of the LORD; this is what I desire: to dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to gaze on the beauty of the LORD and seek Him in His temple.
and on that day you will say: “Give praise to the LORD; proclaim His name! Make His works known among the peoples; declare that His name is exalted.
My mouth is filled with Your praise and with Your splendor all day long.

verses.text: Blessed are those whose strength is in You, whose hearts are set on pilgrimage.

xrefs.text: The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in Him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart rejoices, and I give thanks to Him with my song.
But He said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for My power is perfected in weakness. Therefore I will boast all the more gladly in my weaknesses, so that the power of Christ may rest on me.
I will strengthen them in the LORD, and in His name they will walk,” declares the LORD.
I can do all things through Christ who gives me strength.
I delight to do Your will, O my God; Your law is within my heart.”

verses.text: As they pass through the Valley of Baca, they make it a place of springs; even the autumn rain covers it with pools.

xrefs.text: For our light and momentary affliction is producing for us an eternal weight of glory that is far beyond comparison.
I have told you these things so that in Me you may have peace. In the world you will have tribulation. But take courage; I have overcome the world!
Not only that, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, because we know that suffering produces perseverance;
Be glad, O children of Zion, and rejoice in the LORD your God, for He has given you the autumn rains for your vindication. He sends you showers, both autumn and spring rains, as before.
No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through Him who loved us.

verses.text: They go from strength to strength, until each appears before God in Zion.

xrefs.text: The path of the righteous is like the first gleam of dawn, shining brighter and brighter until midday.
And we, who with unveiled faces all reflect the glory of the Lord, are being transformed into His image with intensifying glory, which comes from the Lord, who is the Spirit.
But those who wait upon the LORD will renew their strength; they will mount up with wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary, they will walk and not faint.
Yet a righteous one holds to his way, and the one with clean hands grows stronger.
From His fullness we have all received grace upon grace.

verses.text: O LORD God of Hosts, hear my prayer; give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah
Take notice of our shield, O God, and look with favor on the face of Your anointed.

xrefs.text: The kings of the earth take their stand and the rulers gather together, against the LORD and against His Anointed One:
A Psalm. Sing to the LORD a new song, for He has done wonders; His right hand and holy arm have gained Him the victory.
After these events, the word of the LORD came to Abram in a vision: “Do not be afraid, Abram. I am your shield, your very great reward.”

Those who oppose the LORD will be shattered. He will thunder from heaven against them. The LORD will judge the ends of the earth and will give power to His king. He will exalt the horn of His anointed.”
I have found My servant David; with My sacred oil I have anointed him.

verses.text: For better is one day in Your courts than a thousand elsewhere. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God than dwell in the tents of the wicked.

xrefs.text: One thing I have asked of the LORD; this is what I desire: to dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to gaze on the beauty of the LORD and seek Him in His temple.
O LORD, I love the house where You dwell, the place where Your glory resides.
So I have seen You in the sanctuary and beheld Your power and glory.
But our citizenship is in heaven, and we eagerly await a Savior from there, the Lord Jesus Christ,
Those who live according to the flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh; but those who live according to the Spirit set their minds on the things of the Spirit.

verses.text: For the LORD God is a sun and a shield; the LORD gives grace and glory; He withholds no good thing from those who walk with integrity.

xrefs.text: Fear the LORD, you His saints, for those who fear Him lack nothing.
He stores up sound wisdom for the upright; He is a shield to those who walk with integrity,
But seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness, and all these things will be added unto you.
And my God will supply all your needs according to His glorious riches in Christ Jesus.
The LORD will indeed provide what is good, and our land will yield its increase.

verses.text: O LORD of Hosts, how blessed is the man who trusts in You!

xrefs.text: But blessed is the man who trusts in the LORD, whose confidence is in Him.
Trust in Him at all times, O people; pour out your hearts before Him. God is our refuge. Selah
Who among you fears the LORD and obeys the voice of His Servant? Who among you walks in darkness and has no light? Let him trust in the name of the LORD; let him lean on his God.
Therefore the LORD longs to be gracious to you; therefore He rises to show you compassion, for the LORD is a just God. Blessed are all who wait for Him.
Kiss the Son, lest He be angry and you perish in your rebellion, when His wrath ignites in an instant. Blessed are all who take refuge in Him.
